title: Length of a nested pair encoding
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $x,u,e$ be bit strings. If $|u|=C(|x|+1)^c$ and $|e|=C(|x|+1)^c+1$, then $|\langle\langle x,u\rangle,e\rangle|=q(C,c,x)$, where $q(C,c,x)=2\bigl(2|x|+2+C(|x|+1)^c\bigr)+2+C(|x|+1)^c+1$.
